The glyme electrolyte was picked to overcome this problem, which they judged critical for good cycling. Coin cells used NaPF6 salt dissolved in tetraglyme. The text says the glyme electrolyte was chosen to overcome the unstable SEI formation on Na metal anodes observed in carbonate-based electrolytes[1]. Their choice of tetraglyme was opposed to traditional organic carbonate electrolytes, as stated in opposed to using traditional organic carbonate electrolytes[2], and the electrolyte is tetraglyme as electrolyte[3].
